description: Only call this when the customer asks about their own Fold account, saved details or orders — it requires their connected Fold account and asks them to sign in. Prices, ZIP coverage, estimates and guest orders work without signing in (get_pricing, check_service_zip, get_estimate, book_residential_pickup). Returns their saved addresses (with gate code / access notes), whether a card is on file, Fold credit balance, Fold Club membership, laundry care preferences (detergent, water temperature, special instructions) and recurring pickups. book_my_pickup uses these saved details.
name: get_my_account
title: My Fold account
